小区.meaning: residential compound: 我们小区 our compound, 住在小区里 live in the compound

小心.meaning: careful; cautious: 开车小心 drive carefully, 小心点儿 be careful
to beware of; to mind: 小心玻璃 careful, glass, 小心别摔跤 mind you don't fall

校园.meaning: campus; school grounds: 校园里有很多树 the campus has many trees, 校园生活 campus life

校长.meaning: principal; headmaster: 王校长 Principal Wang

夏天.meaning: summer: 夏天很热 summer is hot

西北.meaning: northwest: 西北风 northwest wind, 西北地区 the northwest region

鞋.meaning: shoe (measure word 双): 一双鞋 a pair of shoes, 运动鞋 sneakers

西方.meaning: the West; the Western world: 西方文化 Western culture
the west (direction, formal; everyday word is 西边)

西瓜.meaning: watermelon: 一块西瓜 a slice of watermelon, 夏天吃西瓜 eat watermelon in summer

习惯.meaning: habit; to be accustomed to: 好习惯 a good habit, 习惯了中国菜 be used to Chinese food

信.meaning: letter; mail: 写信 write a letter, 一封信 a letter (also bound in 信息 information, 短信 text message)
to believe (bound form 相信/信任): 深信不疑 — beyond level

西南.meaning: southwest: 房间的西南面 the southwest side of the room

行.meaning: to be okay; to do (colloquial): 行！ okay!, 这个办法行 this method works
to walk; to travel (bound form: 自行车 bicycle, 步行 on foot, 旅行 travel)
row; line; trade; firm: 一行字 a line of text, 各行各业 all walks of life (银行 bank) — beyond HSK3

行李.meaning: luggage; baggage: 行李箱 suitcase, 行李很重 the luggage is heavy (no plural form)

兴趣.meaning: interest: 对音乐感兴趣 be interested in music, 兴趣爱好 interests and hobbies

心里.meaning: in the heart; in the mind: 心里很高兴 feel happy inside, 心里想 think to oneself

新年.meaning: New Year: 新年快乐 Happy New Year

新闻.meaning: news: 看新闻 watch the news, 一条新闻 a news item

新鲜.meaning: fresh: 新鲜水果 fresh fruit, 空气很新鲜 the air is fresh

信用卡.meaning: credit card: 用信用卡付款 pay by credit card

休假.meaning: to take a vacation; vacation (formal): 去海南休假 take a vacation in Hainan

洗衣机.meaning: washing machine: 把衣服放进洗衣机 put the clothes in the washing machine

洗澡.meaning: to take a bath or shower: 洗个澡 take a shower (separable: 洗了两次澡)

选.meaning: to choose; to select; to elect: 选课 choose courses, 选他当班长 elect him class monitor

选择.meaning: to choose; choice; option: 自己选择 choose for yourself, 没有别的选择 no other choice

学期.meaning: semester; school term: 这个学期 this semester, 新学期 the new term

需要.meaning: to need; to require: 需要帮忙 need help, 身体需要休息 the body needs rest

牙.meaning: tooth: 刷牙 brush one's teeth, 牙疼 toothache

羊.meaning: sheep; goat (measure word 只): 一只羊 a sheep; bound in 山羊 goat, 绵羊 sheep

养.meaning: to raise; to keep (animals or plants): 养狗 keep a dog, 养花 grow flowers
to support; to bring up (people); to cultivate: 养家 support a family, 养成好习惯 develop good habits

要求.meaning: to request; to demand; requirement: 老师要求我们准时到 the teacher requires us to be on time, 满足要求 meet the requirements

牙刷.meaning: toothbrush: 一把牙刷 a toothbrush, 换牙刷 replace the toothbrush

页.meaning: measure word for pages: 第一页 page one, 翻到第五十页 turn to page 50

一般.meaning: ordinary; average; so-so: 水平一般 average level, 一般般 just so-so
generally; usually: 他一般七点起床 he usually gets up at seven

一边.meaning: while… (one action at the same time as another; 一边…一边…): 一边吃饭一边看电视 eat while watching TV
one side: 河的一边 one side of the river

一定.meaning: certainly; definitely: 他一定会来 he will definitely come, 一定行 it will surely work
definite; certain; a certain amount: 一定的水平 a certain level, 没有一定的答案 there is no fixed answer

一共.meaning: in total; altogether: 一共二十个人 twenty people altogether, 一共花了五十块 spent fifty yuan in total

以后.meaning: after; afterwards; later: 下课以后 after class, 以后再说 talk about it later

一块儿.meaning: together (colloquial; 一起 more standard): 我们一块儿去吧 let's go together

应该.meaning: should; ought to: 你应该早点儿睡 you should sleep earlier, 应该没问题 should be fine

影响.meaning: to influence; to affect; influence; effect: 影响学习 affect one's studies, 有很大的影响 have a big effect

银行.meaning: bank: 去银行取钱 go to the bank to withdraw money (行 read háng here)

银行卡.meaning: bank card (debit or credit): 用银行卡支付 pay by bank card

饮料.meaning: drink; beverage (measure word 杯/瓶): 一瓶饮料 a bottle of drink, 冷饮料 cold drinks

音乐.meaning: music: 听音乐 listen to music, 音乐会 a concert

以前.meaning: before; in the past: 以前他住在北京 he used to live in Beijing, 十点以前 before ten o'clock

以上.meaning: the above; or more (exceeding a stated amount): 六十人以上 sixty or more people, 以上内容仅供参考 the above is for reference only

以外.meaning: beyond; outside of; apart from: 三公里以外 more than three kilometers away, 除了他以外 apart from him

以为.meaning: to think mistakenly; to assume (implies the belief turned out wrong): 我以为你知道 I thought you knew, 他以为明天放假 he assumed tomorrow was a holiday

以下.meaning: the following; below (a stated amount): 十岁以下 under ten years old, 以下重点 the following key points

一样.meaning: the same; alike: 我们俩一样大 we're the same age, 和…一样 the same as…
equally (before an adjective): 一样高 equally tall

一直.meaning: always; all along; straight ahead: 他一直在学汉语 he's been studying Chinese all along, 一直往前走 keep going straight

用.meaning: to use: 用筷子吃 eat with chopsticks, 用英语说 say it in English; bound in 有用 useful, 没用 useless
expense (bound form 费用/用钱 — beyond level)

又.meaning: again (for past/completed repetition): 他又来了 he came again (future repetition uses 再)
(又…又…) both…and; 又高又帅 tall and handsome, 又便宜又好 cheap and good

有关.meaning: related to; concerned with: 有关问题 related questions, 和气候有关 have to do with the climate

邮件.meaning: email; mail: 发邮件 send an email, 检查邮件 check one's email

游客.meaning: tourist; visitor: 很多游客 many tourists, 游客中心 the visitor center

有名.meaning: famous; well-known: 一位有名的作家 a famous writer

游戏.meaning: game (measure word 个/场): 玩游戏 play games, 电子游戏 video games

邮箱.meaning: email inbox; mailbox: 发到我邮箱 send it to my inbox, 查邮箱 check the mailbox

有用.meaning: useful: 这本书很有用 this book is very useful (opposite: 没用 useless)

园.meaning: garden; park (bound form only: 公园 park, 动物园 zoo, 校园 campus)

员.meaning: member; personnel (bound suffix only: 演员 actor, 服务员 waiter, 运动员 athlete)

愿意.meaning: to be willing to: 你愿意帮忙吗 would you be willing to help?, 我愿意 I'm willing (also the wedding 'I do')

遇到.meaning: to encounter; to run into (a person or difficulty): 遇到老朋友 ran into an old friend, 遇到困难 encounter difficulties

越.meaning: the more…the more… (越…越…): 越来越 more and more, 越多越好 the more the better

月亮.meaning: the moon: 今晚的月亮真圆 the moon is so round tonight

遇见.meaning: to meet by chance; to run into: 在路上遇见了老师 ran into the teacher on the way (遇到 more common in speech)

羽毛球.meaning: badminton: 打羽毛球 play badminton

运动会.meaning: sports meet; sports day: 学校开运动会 the school is holding a sports meet

运动员.meaning: athlete; player: 一名著名运动员 a famous athlete

语言.meaning: language (language in general; a specific language word is often 外语 etc.): 学一门语言 learn a language, 语言水平 language level

雨衣.meaning: raincoat: 下雨了，穿雨衣 it's raining, wear a raincoat

脏.meaning: dirty: 手很脏 hands are dirty, 又脏又乱 dirty and messy

咱们.meaning: we (inclusive — includes the listener): 咱们走吧 let's go (我们 excludes the listener or is neutral)

怎么办.meaning: what to do; what should (we) do: 忘了带钥匙，怎么办 I forgot the keys — what now?

怎样.meaning: how; in what way: 怎样才能学好汉语 how can one learn Chinese well? (怎么样 asks 'how is it'; 怎样 leans 'by what means')

站2.meaning: to stand: 站起来 stand up, 站了半天 stood for ages
station; stop: 火车站 train station, 下一站 next stop

长.meaning: long (length or duration): 头发很长 long hair, 会议很长 the meeting is long
to grow; to grow up: 长大了 grown up, 长得像爸爸 looks like his dad
head; chief (bound form: 校长 principal, 市长 mayor) — beyond HSK3

张.meaning: measure word for flat objects (paper, tickets, tables, beds, faces): 一张纸 a sheet of paper, 一张桌子 a table
to open; to spread (张嘴 open one's mouth — beyond level)

照.meaning: to take a photo (in 拍照/照相): 帮我照张像 take a photo for me
according to; in the manner of: 照他说的做 do as he says, 照这个办法办 do it this way
to shine; to reflect (阳光照进来 the sunlight shines in — beyond level)

照顾.meaning: to look after; to care for: 照顾孩子 look after children, 在家照顾父母 care for parents at home

着急.meaning: anxious; worried; in a rush: 别着急 don't worry, 着急用 need to use it right away

照片.meaning: photo; picture (measure word 张): 一张照片 a photo, 拍照片 take photos

照相.meaning: to take a photo: 去公园照相 go take photos in the park — separable: 照张相

只.meaning: only; just: 只有一个 only one, 他只喝咖啡 he only drinks coffee
measure word for animals and one of a pair: 一只猫 a cat, 一只鞋 one shoe
one of a pair (bound use: 只脚 one foot — standalone rare)

纸.meaning: paper (measure word 张): 一张纸 a sheet of paper, 一张白纸 a sheet of white paper

只能.meaning: can only; have no choice but to: 只能等 can only wait, 只能这样了 it can only be this way

直到.meaning: until; up to (a time or state): 直到半夜 until midnight, 直到现在才明白 only now understand

只是.meaning: merely; it's just that: 只是想帮忙 just wanted to help, 他只是累了 he was just tired
but; only (mild contrast after a concession): 想去，只是没时间 I'd like to go, only I have no time

只要.meaning: as long as; provided that (usually with 就): 只要努力，就能学好 as long as you work hard, you can learn it well

只有.meaning: only; alone (a sole instance): 只有他来了 only he came, 只有一次 only once
only if; only when (只有…才…): 只有努力才能成功 only by working hard can one succeed

种.meaning: measure word for kinds and types: 一种水果 a kind of fruit, 这种方法 this method
to plant; to grow (crops or plants): 种花 grow flowers, 种树 plant trees

中.meaning: middle; center; among; in: 家中 at home, 心中 in one's heart (bound form; 中 in 中国 China, 中文 Chinese)
to hit the mark; to be hit by (中奖 win a lottery, 看中 take a fancy to — beyond level)

中间.meaning: middle; center; between: 桌子中间 the middle of the table, 坐在中间 sit in the middle, 两者之间 between the two

重要.meaning: important; major: 很重要 very important, 重要的问题 an important question

终于.meaning: finally; at last (after long expectation): 终于到了 finally arrived, 终于考完了 the exams are finally over

周末.meaning: weekend: 周末愉快 have a nice weekend, 这个周末 this weekend

主要.meaning: main; principal; primarily: 主要原因 the main reason, 主要是他 mainly it's him

注意.meaning: to pay attention to; attention: 注意安全 mind your safety, 没注意到 didn't notice

住院.meaning: to be hospitalized: 他住院了 he's in the hospital — separable: 住了三天院

子.meaning: child; son; seed (bound suffix only: 儿子 son, 孩子 child, 种子 seed)

字典.meaning: character dictionary (a 字典 lists characters; a 词典 lists words): 查字典 look it up in the dictionary

自行车.meaning: bicycle (measure word 辆): 骑自行车去 go by bike

总.meaning: anyway; after all (colloquial sentence adverb, 总得/总会/总不能): 总得有个办法 there must be some way — mostly bound (总共, 总是)

总是.meaning: always: 他总是迟到 he's always late, 总是很忙 always busy

嘴.meaning: mouth: 张开嘴 open your mouth, 嘴里含着糖 has candy in his mouth

最好.meaning: had better; it would be best: 你最好早点儿来 you'd better come early
best; the finest: 最好的朋友 one's best friend

最后.meaning: last; final; finally: 最后一课 the last lesson, 谁最后走 who leaves last?

最近.meaning: recently; lately: 最近很忙 very busy lately, 最近怎么样 how have you been?

做客.meaning: to be a guest at someone's home: 去朋友家做客 be a guest at a friend's home

作业.meaning: homework; assignment: 做作业 do homework, 交作业 hand in homework
